score_descriptions.total_core_hours: Total CPU core-hours of requested compute (executor_count x cores x elapsed / 3600). Uses per-job profile cores from K8s manifest, not the global executor.cores config value
score_descriptions.compute_efficiency_gb_per_core_hour: GB processed per core-hour of requested compute (higher is better)
score_descriptions.total_data_processed_gb: Sum of input data across all pipeline stages in GB
score_descriptions.pipeline_throughput_gb_per_second: Total data / wall-clock time in GB/s (higher is better)
score_descriptions.total_elapsed_seconds: Wall-clock seconds from pipeline start to final stage completion
score_descriptions.composite_qph: Queries per Hour -- median of in-stream rounds or single benchmark (higher is better)
score_descriptions.data_freshness_seconds: Primary freshness score. Worst-case gold table staleness during the streaming window in seconds (lower is better)
score_descriptions.sustained_throughput_rps: Rows entering bronze per second (higher is better)
score_descriptions.ingest_ratio: Bronze rows ingested / datagen rows produced (1.0 = all data consumed)
score_descriptions.stage_latency_profile: Average micro-batch processing time per stage {bronze_ms, silver_ms, gold_ms} in ms
score_descriptions.pipeline_saturated: True when ingest_ratio < 0.95 -- pipeline cannot keep pace with input; intake_limit says whether bronze processing was the limit
score_descriptions.intake_limit: What bounded intake when ingest_ratio < 0.95: bronze_capacity (bronze busy for most of the window; sustained_throughput_rps is its capacity), below_bronze_capacity (bronze had idle time: the trigger rate, a late start or a stall; the throughput is not bronze's capacity), none (kept up)
score_descriptions.bronze_busy_fraction: Share of the window bronze spent inside micro-batches (batches x mean batch time / window)
score_descriptions.time_to_detect_seconds: AML continuous. Median seconds from the newest bronze ingest of an alert's related transactions to the end of the detection pass that first raised it (lower is better)
score_descriptions.time_to_detect_p95_seconds: AML continuous. 95th percentile of time_to_detect (histogram bin upper edge, 10 s bins)
score_descriptions.time_to_detect_max_seconds: AML continuous. Longest time to detect of any newly raised alert
score_descriptions.time_to_detect_alerts: AML continuous. Newly raised alerts the time to detect is measured over
score_descriptions.time_to_detect_late_alerts: AML continuous. Measured alerts whose related transactions were all in silver before the previous detection pass (re-raised after a rule error, or evidence outside related_txn_ids); included in the percentiles
score_descriptions.time_to_detect_unmeasured_cycles: AML continuous. Gold cycles that logged no time-to-detect line; their alerts are measured on the next cycle, late by one cycle
score_descriptions.corpus_drained: True when the finite corpus was fully ingested before the window ended: freshness covers only cycles that saw new data, and sustained_throughput_rps is a lower bound
score_descriptions.total_rows_processed: Cumulative rows processed across all streaming stages
score_descriptions.total_s3_objects: Total S3 objects across bronze/silver/gold buckets at end of run. Growth rate vs retention capacity is the key signal -- if this grows unbounded, metadata ops degrade
score_descriptions.in_stream_composite_qph: Median QpH from in-stream benchmark rounds
score_descriptions.benchmark_rounds_count: Number of in-stream benchmark rounds executed
score_descriptions.qph_degradation_pct: QpH degradation from first-half to second-half of sustained run (positive = slower, negative = faster)
